generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The quoted prices should be exclusive of GST.

technicalCriterionList.description: The prospective Bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor at least one work of Overhauling/servicing or repairs of SF6 CBs of rating 110KV and above in any power stations/substations/ any reputed organizations of value not less than Rs.2.2 Lakhs in the preceding five years (i.e.,2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of this, the bidder should submit a copy of work done certificate and corresponding work order issued by competent authority. (in case of state/ central government/ Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer). (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work to bring the current price level of 2026-27).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of corresponding work order

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder in his name, should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.4.4 Lakhs in at least any two financial years of the last five years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of this, Turnover Certificate duly certified by Charted Accountant shall be furnished. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover to bring the current price level of 2026-27).

itemList.description:
Service charges for overhauling of mechanism including supply of overhauling kit.
1) Mechanism door beeding - 8meters 
2) View glass with rubber beedings - 3no.s 
3) Non-Return Bearing(NRB) assembly - 1no. 
4) Grease locktite 8103 - 200grams
Carrying out CRM,DCRM & Timing test for overhauled CBs and submission of test reports.
